Third-party code in this folder
===============================

mediabunny.min.mjs
  Mediabunny v1.66.0 by Vanilagy - https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny
  License: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (LICENSE-MPL-2.0.txt)
  Source: npm package "mediabunny", dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs (unmodified)

mediabunny-aac-encoder.min.mjs
  @mediabunny/aac-encoder v1.66.0 by Vanilagy - https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny
  License: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (LICENSE-MPL-2.0.txt)
  Source: npm package "@mediabunny/aac-encoder", dist/bundles/mediabunny-aac-encoder.min.mjs
  MODIFIED: the bare import specifier "mediabunny" was changed to "./mediabunny.min.mjs"
  so the file loads in the browser without a bundler. No other changes.
  Contains a WebAssembly build of FFmpeg's AAC encoder, licensed LGPL v2.1+
  (LICENSE-FFmpeg.md). FFmpeg source: https://ffmpeg.org/download.html
  Build script: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/main/packages/aac-encoder

Updating: npm pack both packages at the same version, copy the two .min.mjs bundles
here, and re-apply the import change above.
